{{Quote|Seron's organization has grown rapidly since the death of Jabba the Hutt &mdash; many from Jabba's organization have found their way into the ranks of Seron's. Like many master criminals, Seron has been able to direct a complete organization while being able to insulate himself enough from activities so that there is little hard evidence against him.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="WBC" />}}
'''Gornt Seron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hethas]] gangster and [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who operated during the [[New Republic era]]. His base of operation was the planet [[Korbin]]. Seron's known employees included two members of an [[unidentified stalk-eyed species]] that were on relatively familiar terms with him. He also employed [[Kin Laron]], an assassin. Laron was dispatched to hunt down the criminal [[Den Hardon]], who was wanted by Seron.

==Biography==
Gornt Seron was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korbin]] in [[48 BBY/Legends|48 BBY]], the son of criminals stranded on the world. Over several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of criminal activity, Seron amassed a fortune and became one of the more prominent [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] on Korbin. Seron's illegal activities stretched from Korbin to several other worlds, and his primary interest was illegal [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], although he was known to dabble in extortion, [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], and [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms running]]. Seron's handling of his businesses was so adept that little evidence of his illegal activities could be found. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] resorted to charging Seron with underreporting the income of his legitimate business holdings. The New Republic believed that the companies were fronts of handling contraband goods and laundering dirty credits.<ref name="WBC" />

Seron benefited from the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] by absorbing elements of his organization. The crime lord once acquired detailed information on the New Republic's plans to deal with the remnants of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Seron's agents contacted the New Republic, demanding 200,000 credits which was reluctantly paid although no evidence was found that Seron was directly involved. As a result, all New Republic agents had standing orders to arrest Seron on sight, and the New Republic posted a reward of 75,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for Seron's capture on charges of intent to defraud the New Republic government of tax revenues.<ref name="WBC" /> In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], Seron killed [[Sub-Prefect]] [[Neris]] for refusing to be corrupted. Seron had also killed Neris' predecessor, [[Bregless]].<ref name="PAL">{{WEGCite|story=A Physical Application Of The Law|book=Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Seron was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hethas]] who stood two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="WBC" />

==Skills and abilities==
Seron was skilled with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and knowledgeable about [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], cultures, languages, and [[Star system/Legends|planetary systems]]. He also had a working understanding of [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] procedure, and was knowledgeable about the value of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="WBC" />

==Equipment==
Seron carried a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="WBC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Seron was profiled in [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], a sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] in [[1993]]. The illustration of Seron was provided by [[Mike Vilardi]].
